prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 13 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1438; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with complaints of right shoulder pain and restricted range of motion. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported symptoms, and the injury pattern is plausible for a crash of this type. Over the course of 13 visits, treatment included physical therapy, home exercise instruction, and periodic reassessment. The course of care ran somewhat longer than is typical for this presentation, and progress was gradual. On examination, several findings support a soft tissue injury to the shoulder, including tenderness along the rotator cuff and pain with resisted abduction. Other tests, including neurovascular screening and imaging-based assessments where performed, were within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment involving the same shoulder is known to this provider. Billing records reviewed for this episode reflect single charges for each visit with no duplicate entries. Plan going forward is continued home exercise and follow-up as needed.
